seoTitle: Missing Value Filler: Constant, Mean, Median, Forward Fill
metaDescription: Fill empty CSV cells per column with a constant, mean, median, or the previous or next value. Free, shows how many were filled.
intro: Replaces empty cells column by column using the method you choose, with one default and overrides for single columns.
why:
Gaps in data break charts and averages. Filling with a mean or the last value is a modelling choice, so the tool tells you how many cells were changed in each column and which method it used.

Mean and median need numbers; forward and backward fill work for text as well, and leave leading or trailing gaps empty if there is nothing to copy. Writing overrides such as temp: mean; city: forward lets you mix methods. Filled values are guesses; keep the original file.
howTo: Paste the CSV with a header.
Add overrides like temp: mean; city: forward.
Copy or download the filled CSV.

faq.a: A cell with nothing or only spaces.

faq.q: Can I fill with a fixed word?
faq.a: Yes, choose constant and type it, or use const=VALUE in an override.
